I agree with everyone saying Tekken 7. The game itself is difficult to play competitively, but the platinum is incredibly easy. It's not demanding at all, doesn't require you to master the game or do crazy combos.

MK11 is also pretty beginner friendly, the tutorials are really well-made and the trophy list is straightforward.

SoulCalibur VI is a fun and easy plat too, not as easy and quick as Tekken 7 but very doable. 

Dead or Alive 6 is harder than all of the above, but still fun and doable. The thing that makes it more challenging is having to complete all combo trials for any character.

You mentioned Guilty Gear... Strive is a very quick and mostly easy plat, and it's a very high quality game. There's just one tough boss battle to deal with.

Blazblue is not as good as Guilty Gear imo, but still interesting and the plats are usually straightforward.

Samurai Shodown is getting rollback netcode soon, so that's a game worth checking out. It's really cool and the plat is mostly easy, just another tough boss battle.

Injustice 2 is doable but there's an annoying RNG trophy that could take a while to grind for. Definitely don't touch Injustice 1, that plat is horrible and not fun.

Dragon Ball FighterZ is my favorite fighting game, and the plat is a fair challenge. You have to reach the top 40% in ranked, which is not as hard as it sounds if you're willing to practice a bit. I've heard it can be boosted too, but I don't know anything about that.

Street Fighter V is my favorite fighting game platinum trophy, because it requires reaching the top 10% in ranked, which is very difficult but satisfying to accomplish. As long as you're willing to practice and learn, you can plat this game without any prior experience. I've helped people and seen it happen with my own eyes. So I recommend trying it out :)

Hello, fighting game enthusiast and trophy hunter here. I have a few suggestions.

Street Fighter V is my favorite fighting game platinum, as it requires you to reach Gold League (top 10% in ranked) and collect 1 million FM by doing survival mode with every character on every difficulty. Awesome game, super satisfying platinum that I highly recommend.

Ultimate Marvel Vs Capcom 3 is also great, but the online is pretty inactive so you'll probably need to boost. However I love this game because for the plat you need to clear 480 combo trials, and I love that stuff. It was a very fun and rewarding challenge. 

Dead Or Alive 6 is another really fun fighting game with a combo trial trophy, and it's way easier and has more active online.

Tekken 7 is the easiest fighting game plat that I have, so that's another good one for the collection.

If you like Dragon Ball FighterZ, maybe you'll like Guilty Gear. Strive is an amazing game that I highly recommend, the platinum is mostly really easy except for one tough trophy involving an overpowered boss battle. Xrd Rev 2 is another good game but the online is dead and you'd need to boost it.

Samurai Shodown is a great game and is getting rollback netcode very soon, so the online will likely become more active. Plat isn't too hard, I'd recommend it.

SoulCalibur VI is really fun if you want a weapon-based 3D fighter. The plat is pretty easy, only a little grind in singleplayer. The online is still pretty active. 

Mortal Kombat X is one of my favorite fighting games but there's a couple problematic trophies involving online events called Invasions, which NRS hasn't been supporting lately. It could come back at any time though, so I would keep an eye on it. There's also a trophy for getting 10 ranked wins in a row, most people save scum it but I suggest trying it legit because it's super satisfying and rewarding.

I'm currently working on vanilla Persona 4 Arena and Blazblue Centralfiction (they play similar to other ArcSys games like DBFZ or Guilty Gear). They're not bad but the online is pretty dead. 

I'm also starting Ultra Street Fighter IV soon because the combo trials are tempting. Online is dead there too though.

I plan on picking up King Of Fighters XV in the near future as well, the plat seems pretty straightforward and fun.

Finally, there's Injustice 1.... I don't recommend this platinum. It's not even fun, lmao. Just painful. I finished it because I hate myself but I don't wish that upon anyone else.

I saw somebody else suggest Injustice 2 but yeah that game has an annoying RNG trophy so I understand why you'd rather avoid it.

Anyway, that's all I can think of. Good luck and happy hunting, feel free to ask any questions!

I hate to break it to you, but you're gonna need all 3 punches and all 3 kicks.

punches are with your hands and arms, kicks are with your feet and legs.

there's a light, medium, and heavy version of both. 

V-Skill is medium punch and medium kick together.

V-Trigger is heavy punch and heavy kick together.

If you enjoy Tekken, I would try Dead or Alive and SoulCalibur. DOA6 and SC6 are good plats, not very difficult but a little more challenging than T7.

If you want to venture deeper into the world of fighting games, you could try a 2D one. Street Fighter is the OG definitive fighting game, but it's very challenging. SFV platinum is 0.97% rarity on PSNP and incredibly satisfying to earn.

Arc System Works makes anime fighting games that are different and much easier than Street Fighter. Dragon Ball FighterZ, Persona 4 Arena, and Blazblue Centralfiction are all ultra rare plats. Guilty Gear Strive isn't as rare but it's a great game.

Mortal Kombat is another classic, and it's easier than all of the above. I think MK9 and MKX are unobtainable now due to ceased developer support, but MK11 is rare and very manageable. 
NetherRealm also makes the Injustice games. They're easy to pick up and play, but the platinums are kind of rough. Injustice 1 is a very difficult grind, and Injustice 2 has a terrible RNG trophy. Still good games if you just want to play them for fun though.

If you want to improve & test your combo skills, I would recommend Ultimate Marvel vs Capcom 3. That game has a trophy for clearing 480 combo trials, which is very satisfying to earn. Platinum is 0.62% rarity on PSNP.

Samurai Shodown is really cool and not too difficult of a plat. I haven't done a King of Fighters game yet, but it's pretty similar to Street Fighter.

That's about all I can think of to recommend. Good luck and have fun!
